statement.zh: **人物**：詹姆斯·埃利斯（James Ellis）。本行是人物行，其原理对应 Ellis 在 CESG 提出非秘密加密这一事实。留存追述的导言印出「work by James and others in CESG」与「of the invention and development within CESG of non-secret encryption (NSE)」，正文又印出「NSE was my idea」。因此该条目把 Ellis 定位为非秘密加密（NSE）这一想法的提出者，不把后来公开的 RSA 或 Diffie-Hellman 方案归到他名下。
statement.en: **Person**: James Ellis.It is registered under asymmetric public-key cryptography.

statement.zh: 理论贡献由正文印出：他先写「We had an existence theorem.」，再写「I published the existence theorem in 1970」。因此该条目只说 Ellis 在 1970 年发表存在性定理，证明无需预先交换密钥的保密通信在理论上可行，不把该定理当成可实施的 RSA 方案。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in asymmetric public-key cryptography, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 人物与机构的关系由导言与正文印出：这份追述写的是「work by James and others in CESG」，正文说明其主题是「of the invention and development within CESG of non-secret encryption (NSE)」。因此该条目只把 Ellis 的用途落在 CESG 内部的理论论证与历史记录上，不称他参与公开标准制定。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 边界由正文自己印出：「Because of the weakness of my number theory」与「were left to others.」。因此该条目只说 Ellis 自述数论能力有限、把可实施实现留给他人，不把这句话读成他对 RSA 实现的直接贡献。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh:
可断代的坐标由留存件印出：导言说「This paper by James Ellis was written in 1987.」，正文署名「by J H ELLIS」，Cryptome 说明「Posted 16th December 1997.」。因此该条目把这份追述断到 1987 年写作、1997 年 12 月 16 日公开贴出，不写他生卒年等未印出信息。**可核角色与证据链**
